'''Bekos Maatu''' was a famous "urban explorer" during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He arranged an expedition into the unmapped lower levels of the [[City/Legends|city]]-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and the expedition discovered entire sectors of lost technology and inhabitants cut off from the upper levels.
